description: This file defines an interface `S3ResultMutator` for AWS SDK's S3 component, which is used to modify or alter the result of an S3 operation before returning it to the user. It declares a single method `__invoke` that takes a result, command, and response, and returns a modified result.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Method to modify and return the result of an S3 request, given the result, command, and response objects.
